close_reason: Fixed in bca99b3. Changed principal.rs:121 to use server_fail_from_backend(&e) matching the rest of the crate, and added regression test get_availability_other_error_is_redacted_on_the_wire that asserts a canary literal supplied by a FaultyBackend's AvailabilityError::Other does NOT reach the wire and the description equals SERVER_FAIL_INTERNAL_DESC. cargo test/clippy/doc all green.
description:
crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/principal.rs:121 maps `AvailabilityError::Other(e)` via `JmapError::server_fail(e.to_string())` — leaking the backend error's full `Display` output into the JMAP wire `description` field.

Every other backend-error site in this same handler (line 31 `account_exists`) and every other handler in the crate (calendar.rs:68, event.rs:45-46, event.rs:105, event.rs:179-180, etc.) uses `server_fail_from_backend(&e)` from jmap-server.

`server_fail_from_backend` (crate-jmap-server/src/handlers.rs:78-80) DELIBERATELY redacts to a constant `SERVER_FAIL_INTERNAL_DESC`. The doc-comment at handlers.rs:67-77 EXPLICITLY tells callers to use this helper INSTEAD of `JmapError::server_fail(e.to_string())`.

What callers cannot rely on:

- The trait's `AvailabilityError` rustdoc at backend.rs:649-650 does not warn implementors that their `Other` variant's `Display` output reaches the wire through a different path than other `Self::Error` variants in this crate. A backend author who carefully redacts secrets in `Self::Error::Display` (per the workspace `JmapBackend::Error` Display MUST-NOT contract tracked in JMAP-jfia.20) will see their redaction defeated for this one variant.
- Hand-rolling `e.to_string()` here means the wire description is whatever the backend's `Display` produces, which may include account ids, principal ids, database error text, or stack-trace-flavored output — none of which the constant `SERVER_FAIL_INTERNAL_DESC` would have included.
- Once the inconsistency ships, fixing it is a behavioral change visible to clients (the wire description changes from leaky text to "Internal server failure"), so it ages into a SemVer-adjacent compatibility wart.

Fix is a one-line change: `Err(AvailabilityError::Other(e)) => Err(server_fail_from_backend(&e))` matching the rest of the crate. Should be done before the crate's first stable release while the description-text change is still expected/unsurprising.
title: AvailabilityError::Other handler bypasses server_fail_from_backend redaction at principal.rs:121
